_readme: Record-based source of truth for the Lightning (SFX) EmailTemplate 'Investor Welcome Email'. Loaded by scripts/load-lightning-email-templates.apex via idempotent upsert-by-DeveloperName DML (NOT Metadata API deploy) -- same pattern as IR_Lead_Notification_Email.json, established 2026-08-15 for that template. This file is the human-readable/diffable copy of the scalar fields the loader writes; the loader embeds its own copies of these same values directly in Apex (Apex cannot read files at runtime), so if you change a value here, update the loader script to match. The HTML body lives alongside this file in Investor_Welcome_Email.html and is embedded in the loader as a base64 string (avoids Apex single-quote escaping issues) -- regenerate that base64 blob if the .html changes.
_DeveloperName_collision_note: A CLASSIC (Aloha) EmailTemplate already exists in this org with DeveloperName='Investor_Welcome_Email' (Id 00Xak00000nUZnJEAW, in the IR_Email_Templates classic folder). MEASURED 2026-08-15/16 via a real Savepoint-wrapped DML probe against DPEG-IR-Implementation: attempting to insert a second EmailTemplate with that same DeveloperName in a DIFFERENT folder (this Lightning one) was rejected with 'DUPLICATE_DEVELOPER_NAME, This Template Unique Name already exists or has been previously used' -- i.e. EmailTemplate.DeveloperName is unique ORG-WIDE, not merely per-folder. This template therefore uses the distinct DeveloperName 'Investor_Welcome_Email_LTN' while keeping Name/label 'Investor Welcome Email' (Name has no such uniqueness constraint -- the classic template already uses the identical Name with zero conflict). Investor_Welcome_Flow.flow-meta.xml's Get_Investor_Welcome_Email_Template lookup was updated to filter on this DeveloperName instead of the classic one.
Name: Investor Welcome Email
_FolderId_note: Never hardcode a Folder Id. The loader resolves FolderId at runtime via [SELECT Id FROM Folder WHERE DeveloperName = 'IR_Email_Templates_Lightning' AND Type = 'EmailTemplate'] and fails loudly if the folder is missing, exactly like the IR_Lead_Notification_Email loader block.
Subject: Welcome to DPEG Investor Relations, {{{Recipient.FirstName}}}
_Subject_merge_field_note: MEASURED 2026-08-15/16: a merge field in Subject IS valid on an SFX template in this org -- confirmed by direct query of the genuine, untouched Salesforce-shipped OOTB sample 'First_Touch_Introduction_New_Prospects_OOTB_1' (Subject = 'Greetings from {{{Sender.CompanyName}}}'). Note EmailTemplate.Subject is NOT SOQL-filterable (WHERE Subject LIKE ... is rejected with 'field Subject can not be filtered in a query call'), so this had to be confirmed by selecting known DeveloperNames rather than filtering on Subject content.
_RelatedEntityType_note: Set to Contact, not Lead -- this flow (Investor_Welcome_Flow) triggers on Contact (Investor record type) and the Contact IS the recipient, so {{{Recipient.*}}} merge fields resolve correctly here (unlike IR_Lead_Notification_Email, whose recipient is a queue-member User and whose subject is a Lead).
Description: Lightning (SFX) welcome email sent to a newly created Contact with the Investor record type. Sent by Investor_Welcome_Flow with recipientId = the new Contact, logEmailOnSend = true (so the send is logged on the Contact's own activity timeline). Replaces the classic (Aloha) 'Investor Welcome Email' template (DeveloperName Investor_Welcome_Email, IR_Email_Templates folder), which is now unreferenced by any flow but left in place, untouched, per instruction.
_TemplateStyle_writability_note: MEASURED (established on IR_Lead_Notification_Email, reused here without re-testing): TemplateStyle is createable=true but updateable=false. The loader therefore sets it only on INSERT and never includes it in the UPDATE branch.
_html_authoring_constraints: Rules for editing Investor_Welcome_Email.html. (1) TABLES ONLY for layout and EVERY style INLINE -- Outlook renders with the Word engine (no flexbox/grid/float columns) and Gmail's web client strips <style> blocks from <head>, so anything load-bearing must sit on the element. (2) NO external images, webfonts or CSS -- remote assets are blocked by default in most clients and would render the mail as a broken frame; every visual here is built from table cells and background colours. (3) border-radius degrades to square corners in Outlook desktop -- accepted, the layout survives. (4) The hidden preheader div is the grey preview line clients show beside the subject; it uses mso-hide:all, which linters flag as an unknown property -- that warning is expected and must not be 'fixed'. (5) SIZE IS A HARD CONSTRAINT: this file is base64-embedded into scripts/load-lightning-email-templates.apex, which is an ANONYMOUS Apex script capped at ~32,000 characters TOTAL across both templates' blobs plus all the script's own code and comments. MEASURED 2026-08-16: a fully-indented, fully-commented version of this file produced a 15,232-char blob and a 33,958-char script, which the platform rejected at compile with 'Script too large'. That is why this file is tightly indented and why its long-form documentation lives here in the .json instead of in an HTML comment -- an HTML comment costs ~1.33x its length in the blob. Check the script length after regenerating the blob.
_org_copy_can_be_clobbered_by_the_builde: MEASURED 2026-08-16 on DPEG-IR-Implementation. This template was found in the org with IsBuilderContent=true and an HtmlValue of nothing but Email Template Builder scaffolding wrapping the single line 'Hi , We Warmly Welcome to you in the IR.' (Body held the same string, and note the empty 'Hi ,' -- the Recipient merge field had been dropped too). The repo HTML was NOT the cause. Opening an SFX template in Setup's Email Template Builder and saving REGENERATES HtmlValue from the Builder canvas, discarding whatever HtmlValue this loader wrote. Because Markup (the canvas) is not writable via DML for TemplateType='custom' (see the note below), the loader cannot pre-populate the canvas to protect against this. OPERATIONAL RULE: edit this template by changing the .html here and re-running the loader -- never by opening it in Email Template Builder. If someone does open and save it there, the designed body is lost and the loader must be re-run to restore it.
_Markup_and_IsBuilderContent_NOT_INCLUDE: Same platform restrictions measured for IR_Lead_Notification_Email apply identically here: Markup can only be set via DML for TemplateType='visualforce' (this template is 'custom'), and IsBuilderContent is createable=false/updateable=false under all circumstances. Neither field is set by the loader. See IR_Lead_Notification_Email.json for the full measured writeup -- not re-derived here since the underlying platform rule is about TemplateType/field describe flags, not about which specific template row is being written.
